issues.desc: Checklist touches TEST/DONE dirty-file gate behavior and generated-artifact evidence, but the initial scope does not explicitly require PLAN decision/premortem or the process-fact double contract work (process-fact registry + verification script) needed for gate-affecting facts. Add this preparation to the relevant checklist context so implementation cannot become prompt-only or gate-local.

CHK-004 is framed as adding regression coverage, which is a verification activity rather than a user-observable checklist outcome. Fold the BL21 lacZ viewer path into CHK-002/CHK-003 verificationIntent/evidence, or reframe the item as an observable classifier/validation behavior using that path.
